bug_semantics: containerd CRI restore (CRImportCheckpoint) copies container-status annotations from untrusted checkpoint-image metadata into the restored container config (meta.Config.Annotations) and later feeds those annotations to WithCDI during spec generation. A caller with pod-create rights can therefore smuggle cdi.k8s.io annotations from a checkpoint archive, causing host CDI specs to inject device nodes and mounts that were not granted by the live pod spec. Reachable only when CDI is enabled and a matching host CDI spec exists.
flaw_origin: First written in 9e6beafd53919eecd1fb650a76332002cf4c84dd (Adrian Reber; merged via PR #10365). That commit added CRImportCheckpoint, which sets originalAnnotations := containerStatus.GetAnnotations() from the checkpoint StatusDumpFile and assigns meta.Config.Annotations = originalAnnotations after only rewriting Kubernetes hash/restartCount keys. The parent tree already had WithCDI(config.Annotations) on the create path; the new restore path is what first trusted checkpoint annotations as create-time CDI input. No CDI denylist existed until the 2026-06-09 filter fix.
